_comment: Combo numbers. The multiplier multiplies all XP. Proposed numbers; the board judges them in playtests. Multiplier 1.0 means no combo. collision_cut and drain_wait_seconds are decided (Game loop architecture, Decisions).

drift_pay._comment: A whole drift pays once, when it ends (Drifting, Decisions, T-246): seconds of drift times per_second, nothing under min_seconds, at most max. Proposals for the playtest.
